bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
p=/home/admin1/projects/debug-ai/.worktrees/independent-chat-20261128
cid="$(docker ps -q --filter label=com.docker.compose.project=debug-ai --filter label=com.docker.compose.service=debug-ai)"
test -n "$cid"
docker inspect -f '{{.Image}} {{.Config.Image}} {{index .Config.Labels "com.docker.compose.project.working_dir"}} {{index .Config.Labels "com.docker.compose.project.config_files"}} {{index .Config.Labels "com.docker.compose.project.environment_file"}}' "$cid"
for f in "$p/.env" /home/admin1/projects/debug-ai/.env; do if test -f "$f"; then printf 'ENV_EXISTS %s\n' "$f";fi;done
git -C "$p" rev-parse HEAD
git -C "$p" status --porcelain --untracked-files=all
docker exec "$cid" node -e 'const x=JSON.parse(process.env.DEBUG_AI_COMMAND_MODEL_GATES||"{}");console.log(JSON.stringify({qwen:x.qwen35&&{model_id:x.qwen35.model_id,max_output_tokens:x.qwen35.max_output_tokens,runtime_context_tokens:x.qwen35.runtime_context_tokens},deepseek:!!x.deepseek,teaching_flag:process.env.DEBUG_AI_COMMAND_EXTERNAL_QUALIFICATION||"UNSET"}))'
